content.body:
Some of the source map tests are transitive, e.g. https://github.com/tc39/source-map-tests/commit/43d4c57192848a5afd86d927948fa66c61b00fc4

Is following transitive maps something any tools implement?

One might pre-compute the transitive maps, i.e. 'compose' the maps to get a single-step map. Is there any experience with this approach? Any quick thoughts on whether composition would work with the scopes proposal?

Thanks!
